QuestInfo.name: Kampung Merry-go-round
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9270062##k was so impressed with the merry-go-round he saw during his recent trip that he decided to build one in Kampung Village.
QuestInfo.1: In order to build a nice merry-go-round, #b#p9270062##k needs plenty of #b#t4000478#s#k. Will Kampung Village have its very own carousel?
QuestInfo.2: Kampung's very own merry-go-round is finally complete! The kids can't get over how great it is!

0.0: You know, one of the most marvelous things I saw during my recent trip was a big merry-go-round. If we had one of those in Kampung Village, all of our kids would be so happy.
0.1: I think I will just build one myself. I'm quite handy, you know... Ha! But I need some materials to work with. Will you collect some #b#t4000478#s#k for me?

yes.0: I'm glad that you're interested in helping the village. Now, I need at least #b200 #t4000478#s#k from #b#o9420540#s#k to build the entire merry-go-round.

no.0: I thought you loved the kids of Kampung Village just as much as I do.

1.0: Finally! We will soon have our very own merry-go-round!

yes.0: Boy, if not for me we might never get a merry-go-round in Kampung Village. Ha!

item.0: I need at least #b200 #t4000478#s#k to build the entire merry-go-round.

mob.0: You have to hunt at least #b200 #o9420540#s#k to get the #b#t4000478#s#k I need.
